title: Ingress & Gateway API
summary: Expose HTTP(S) apps to the outside world: the legacy Ingress API you will still meet everywhere, and Gateway API, the modern role-oriented standard, with host/path routing, canaries, TLS via cert-manager and cross-namespace rules, all on kind.
objectives: Explain why Services alone are not enough for HTTP traffic and what an L7 proxy/controller adds
Read and write Ingress resources and know the state of ingress-nginx after its 2026 retirement
Describe the Gateway API resource model (GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute, ReferenceGrant) and which role owns each
Install Envoy Gateway on kind and route traffic by host, path and header
Split traffic by weight for a canary release
Terminate TLS at a Gateway using certificates issued by cert-manager from a local CA
Debug routes using status conditions (Accepted, ResolvedRefs, Programmed)
